description: This file contains script code for fetching prompts data from remote URLs, processing the data, and writing the result to a local file. It includes functions for fetching Chinese and English prompts, timeout handling, and the main execution flow.

methods.name: timeoutPromise
methods.description: Creates a promise that rejects after a specified timeout period.

methods.name: fetchCN
methods.description: Fetches Chinese prompts data from a remote URL, filters out prompts containing ignored words.

methods.name: fetchEN
methods.description: Fetches English prompts data from a remote URL, processes text data into prompt pairs.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main async function executing parallel fetches and writing results to a file.
